title: Texas Roadhouse Helps Raise Money for 'Meals on Wheels'
description: COON RAPIDS, Minn. -- A local restaurant gave away free food this week to raise money for a good cause.  On Wednesday and Thursday of this week, Texas Roadhouse offered a free lunch to anyone who came through the doors.  The meal included a pulled pork sandwich, french fries, apple sauce and a drink.    In exchange for the free lunch, customers were asked to donate whatever they could to a local 'Meals on Wheels' program.  Theresa Parthum of Texas Roadhouse says, "We love being a part of our community,  We're a big partner in the community and Meals on Wheels has always been great to us and we love our partners there as well."  Karen Evenson of Impact Services Meals on Wheels says, "They're choosing, in some cases, between their medication and their meals.  So these kinds of events help to make sure that no one has to make that choice, that every single person that needs a nutritious meal every day receives that meal."  This is the fourth year Texas Roadhouse has partnered with Meals on Wheels for the free lunch.  The fundraiser brings in between $8,000-10,000 each year.  (Copyright 2013 by CTN Studios.  All Rights Reserved.)
